summary: A propane mushroom patio heater is about 2.18 m tall (85.8 in) with a head about 0.83 m (32.7 in) across, weighs about 16 kg, burns up to 46,000 BTU and runs from a 20 lb tank in its base. It needs open air and clear space around and above the head. Never use one inside a tent or under a low canopy, keep it away from fabric and guests' hair-height decor, and check with the venue and the fire marshal about fuel storage, clearances and whether a propane heater is allowed at all.
